daily.question: What exact year will artificial general intelligence be achieved? Give a single year, not a range.

question_translations.ar: في أي سنة بالضبط سيتم تحقيق الذكاء الاصطناعي العام؟ أعط سنة واحدة فقط وليس نطاقاً.
question_translations.de: In welchem genauen Jahr wird künstliche allgemeine Intelligenz erreicht? Geben Sie ein einzelnes Jahr an, keine Spanne.
question_translations.es: ¿En qué año exacto se logrará la inteligencia general artificial? Da un solo año, no un rango.
question_translations.fr: En quelle année exacte l'intelligence générale artificielle sera-t-elle réalisée ? Donnez une seule année, pas une plage.
question_translations.hi: कृत्रिम सामान्य बुद्धिमत्ता किस सटीक वर्ष में प्राप्त की जाएगी? एक एकल वर्ष दें, एक श्रृंखला नहीं।
question_translations.it: In che anno esatto sarà raggiunta l'intelligenza artificiale generale? Dai un singolo anno, non un intervallo.
question_translations.ja: 人工汎用知能が達成されるのは正確には何年ですか？範囲ではなく、単一の年を答えてください。
question_translations.ko: 인공일반지능이 정확히 어느 해에 달성될 것인가? 범위가 아닌 단일 연도를 제시하시오.
question_translations.nl: In welk exact jaar zal kunstmatige algemene intelligentie worden bereikt? Geef een enkel jaar, geen bereik.
question_translations.pt: Em que ano exato a inteligência artificial geral será alcançada? Dê um único ano, não um intervalo.
question_translations.ru: В каком точном году будет достигнут искусственный общий интеллект? Дайте один год, а не диапазон.
question_translations.zh: 人工通用智能将在哪一年实现？请给出一个具体年份，而不是一个范围。

volume_profile.note: Volume reduction decided 2026-10-08, first applied on the Measure cycle of 2026-10-09 07:00 Paris: 3 daily (Today's Challenge) + 7 longitudinal (fixed probe) = 10 observations per system per day. Spacing 600000 ms = 10 min between two consecutive observations of the same system, so the 10 passes span 07:00 -> 08:30 Paris instead of a ~15 min burst, while leaving the full 13:30 measurement deadline and the 14:00 publication time untouched. Prompts, active models, generation parameters and evaluator configuration are UNCHANGED: the measuring instrument is identical, so measurement_version / methodology_version are deliberately NOT bumped. Longitudinal volume stays at 7, so the V2 longitudinal baseline (median/MAD over a 14-day window, MAD floor = 100/N/2) remains comparable across the change.
